thread:
Lina Gomez: noticed the HSM section in private-deploy has a stale external tutorial link and no mention of the v1.1 device-path change. opened PR to fix link + add a short migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/451
Tom Becker: good. can we include a tiny SDK example for setting the PKCS#11 module path (python + node) — folks keep hitting \"no module\" errors. also add a one-liner to check device perms.
Lina Gomez: added examples. Python snippet:
```py
from redwood_kms import PKCS11Client, PKCS11Config
conf = PKCS11Config(module_path='/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so', token_label='RedwoodHSM')
client = PKCS11Client(conf)
```
and Node snippet:
```js
const { PKCS11Client } = require('redwood-kms')
const client = new PKCS11Client({ modulePath: '/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so', tokenLabel: 'RedwoodHSM' })
```
Anya Ivanov: add the quick permission check: `ls -l /dev/hsm0` and udev rule suggestion. keep it minimal.
Lina Gomez: added udev rule sample:
```bash
# /etc/udev/rules.d/99-redwood-hsm.rules
KERNEL==\"hsm0\", SUBSYSTEM==\"char\", MODE=\"0660\", GROUP=\"hsm\"
```
Tom Becker: also include SELinux hint. on RHEL we had AVC denies; include audit2allow hint but warn about security review. small example: `ausearch -m avc -ts today | audit2allow -M redwood_hsm`
Lina Gomez: done. added migration blurb: \"installer <=0.9 used /dev/hsm; v1.1 expects /dev/hsm0. If you upgraded in-place, create a symlink: `ln -s /dev/hsm /dev/hsm0` or update udev rules.\"

Tom Becker: looks good, ping me after CI. i will fold snippets into the onboarding checklist after merge. :thumbsup:
